name: Palomar 5 tidal tail, quasar field (Hubble)
blurb: A field in the tidal tail of the globular cluster Palomar 5, seen by Hubble.
label: pal5ttqsoeep1-hubble
story: Stars torn from the globular cluster Palomar 5 stream through this patch of sky. Hubble used distant quasars and galaxies behind them as fixed markers to measure how the cluster and its tail move.

claims.text: Palomar 5 (Pal 5) is a Milky Way globular cluster with prominent tidal tails
This pointing is a tidal tail field beside a QSO
QSOs and galaxies in these fields serve as references to measure the proper motion
